name: Ascii Side View — 3D rotation from front to side
description: Spatial reasoning benchmark: the agent receives a front-view ASCII voxel projection plus a natural-language object description, and must output the correct side view after a 90° rotation. Tests mental 3D rotation — a mug's handle vanishes from the side, L-shapes change silhouette, tunnels become visible or hidden.

binding_vow.description: Single-turn task. Observation: { task, description, front_view (ASCII with #/.), hint }. Action: free-text side-view ASCII art (# = solid, . = empty). Reward is IoU-based (0–1) with a bonus for exact grid match. Episode ends after one submission.

observation_space.description: { task: string, description: string, front_view: string (multiline ASCII), hint: string }

action_space.description: Multiline ASCII art of the side view. Use # for filled voxels and . for empty space. No explanation required — just the grid.

reward.description: IoU between submitted and expected side-view grids (0.85 weight) plus 0.15 exact-match bonus. Partial credit for close answers.
